lines.speaker: Jamie
lines.text: {name}, may oras ka ba ng 30 minutes? Ang ganda ng sunset sa campus oval — gusto lang kitang makausap nang tahimik.
lines.textEn: {name}, got 30 minutes? The sunset over the campus oval is gorgeous — I just wanted to talk quietly with you.

lines.speaker: Jamie
lines.text: Alam kong pareho tayong pagod sa pag-aaral at pagtitipid... pero ikaw 'yung dahilan kung bakit lagi akong excited pumasok araw-araw.
lines.textEn: I know we are both exhausted from school and counting every coin... yet you are the reason I actually look forward to coming to campus every day.

choices.text: 'Ikaw din ang inspirasyon ko, Jamie. Sabay nating abutin ang diploma!'
choices.textEn: 'You are my inspiration too, Jamie. Let us reach graduation side by side!'

journal.title: Sunset kasama si Jamie
journal.summary: Nagkaintindihan kayo ni Jamie — inspirasyon niyo ang isa't isa hanggang graduation.
journal.summaryEn: You and Jamie confessed your feelings — inspiring each other all the way to graduation.

choices.text: 'Salamat Jamie — focus muna tayo sa studies pero lagi akong nandito para sa'yo.'
choices.textEn: 'Thank you Jamie — let us stay focused on school, and I will always be here for you.'

lines.speaker: Jamie
lines.text: Ginawan kita ng flashcards para sa susunod na major exam mo, {name}! At may baon akong homemade sandwich para tipid ka sa lunch!
lines.textEn: I made flashcards for your next major exam, {name}! Plus a homemade sandwich so you save lunch money today!

choices.textEn: You are the absolute best, Jamie! (+Energy, +Mental, +GWA)
